inspection_method: Project files were inspected locally. Public claims were checked against owner-published documentation through text extraction. No public page was treated as a rendered viewport measurement.

owner_url_availability_check.method: HTTP GET with redirects followed; status and nontrivial response size checked

sources.inspected_state: Approved artifact at the understanding gate

claims.claim: The approved product is a download-first public library of 60 accepted design-reference cases with human-readable and structured-data outputs.
IBM Carbon is the single dominant forensic reference; supporting references may have only narrow named roles.

limitations: This source establishes project intent and authority, not facts about public reference systems.

claims.claim: The current Site implements search, lane and facet filters, case detail tabs, and two-to-five-case comparison.
The current Site source does not expose a user-facing case download action.

limitations: Source inspection does not replace a fresh rendered interaction test.

sources.inspected_state: Accepted public case with source, evidence, tokens, coverage, and independent review records

claims.claim: The Carbon case contains four claim-level evidence records and is marked public after independent evidence, originality, rights, and asset review.

limitations: The corpus record does not cover every forensic dimension required by Benchmark 2, so current owner sources were also inspected.

claims.claim: Each screened alternative has a public metadata, source, claim-level evidence, coverage, token, and review record in the canonical corpus.

limitations: Corpus analysis is used for screening. Consequential supporting roles were checked against current owner-published sources.

sources.inspected_state: Owner-published typography strategy documentation; text extraction; no viewport measurement

claims.claim: Carbon uses IBM Plex and separates productive type styles for product work from expressive type styles for editorial web moments.

limitations: This page explains type strategy, not the complete typography of the target Site.

sources.inspected_state: Owner-published grid overview; text extraction; desktop and mobile values documented by the source

claims.claim: Carbon's 2x Grid uses an 8-pixel mini unit, fixed padding multiples, and breakpoint-specific four, eight, and sixteen-column structures.
Carbon recommends testing at each standard breakpoint and permits custom breakpoints for special needs.

limitations: The target may preserve grid relationships without copying Carbon's exact breakpoint values.

sources.inspected_state: Owner-published color overview; text extraction; light and dark layering described by the source

claims.claim: Carbon uses role-based color tokens whose roles remain stable while theme values change.
Neutral grays organize most surfaces, core blue carries primary action, and additional colors are assigned sparingly.

limitations: IBM's literal palette is source identity and is not authorized for copying.

claims.claim: Carbon distinguishes productive and expressive motion and leaves page-level choreography to product teams.
Carbon components include microinteraction motion while larger entrance and exit behavior requires product-specific implementation.

limitations: No target-specific duration or easing was measured from this page.

sources.inspected_state: Owner-published tab guidance and listed accessibility test statuses; text extraction

claims.claim: Carbon assigns tabs to related content groups, content switchers to alternate views of the same content, and warns against tabs when simultaneous comparison is required.
The inspected tabs page lists tested default, advanced, screen-reader, and keyboard states for the current stable component.

limitations: The source's test-status label does not prove the target implementation.

claims.claim: Primer defines header, content, left pane, right pane, and footer regions and adapts multi-column pages to simpler mobile views without loss of functionality.
Primer separates coarse viewport ranges from finer custom breakpoints.

limitations: GitHub's literal shell and product navigation are not adaptation targets.

claims.claim: Primer requires resized text and custom spacing to remain readable without clipping, truncation, obscuring content, or breaking controls.

limitations: This guidance does not establish that the target Site currently passes zoom or text-spacing tests.

claims.claim: EUI describes itself as flexible, composable, accessibility-centered, documented, and tested.
Its published component set includes responsive layout, forms with validation, tables, panels, callouts, and tokens.

limitations: Framework claims are owner claims; target behavior requires separate testing.

claims.claim: EUI assigns flex groups to single-row alignment, flex grids to repeated wrapping rows, and permits semantic elements in place of default div output.

limitations: The target is not adopting EUI layout components or React APIs.

claims.claim: EUI distinguishes opinionated tables with built-in mobile, action, expansion, sorting, pagination, and search behavior from custom tables that transfer accessibility and mobile responsibility to the implementer.

limitations: The target is not adopting EUI code or APIs.

claims.claim: EUI keeps token keys stable across light and dark modes, assigns semantic color roles, and requires state meaning to use icons or copy in addition to color.

limitations: Elastic's literal palette is not an adaptation target.

sources.inspected_state: Owner repository for the public Source site; source text inspection

claims.claim: The public Source page identifies itself as The Guardian Design System and includes separate foundation, typography, color-system, and design-principle sections.
The page states that its color system is based on editorial sections and that each color represents a journalism pillar.

limitations: The primary site could not be parsed directly in the research tool, so the owner-controlled repository was used.

sources.inspected_state: Owner-published font repository documentation; text extraction

claims.claim: Guardian's web typography exposes distinct headline, text Egyptian, and text sans families mapped to Source typography guidance.

limitations: Guardian font files and literal typography are not copied or bundled.

claims.claim: GOV.UK combines styles, accessible components, and task patterns rather than treating page appearance as the whole service.

limitations: Government-service identity and copy are not adaptation targets.

claims.claim: GOV.UK starts with a small-screen single column, limits ordinary reading width, and tells teams to design for screen sizes instead of assuming devices.

limitations: The target Site has different content density and may require a wider working surface.

sources.inspected_state: Owner-published responsive and static spacing guidance; text extraction

claims.claim: GOV.UK's responsive spacing scale changes larger spacing units across its tablet boundary while retaining smaller spacing units.

limitations: The target may adapt the responsive rhythm without copying GOV.UK's literal spacing values.

claims.claim: GOV.UK requires specific error messages that explain what happened and how to fix it, with consistent wording beside the field and in the summary.

limitations: Download and catalog errors need project-specific wording.

claims.claim: Geist publishes foundations, components, icons, and implementation examples for consistent web experiences.

limitations: Vercel brand identity and product evidence are not copied.

claims.claim: Geist assigns separate scale ranges to default, hover, active, border, high-contrast, and text or icon roles.

limitations: The literal monochrome palette is not the transferable relationship.

claims.claim: Geist separates large marketing headings from dashboard headings, multiline copy, compact labels, tabular numbers, and inline-code mono styles.

limitations: Geist Sans and Geist Mono are source choices, not required target fonts.

sources.inspected_state: Owner-published grid component page; text extraction

claims.claim: Geist's grid component provides responsive row and column behavior across three breakpoints.

limitations: The target may use the evidence-frame relationship without using the Geist component.
